windowing.description: Dependencies used by GLFW/Vulkan-backed interactive builds. Headless presets can disable default features before the vcpkg toolchain cutover.

sandbox-editor.description: Dependencies private to the Sandbox editor library (ExtrinsicSandboxEditor). Top-level CMake selects this feature whenever INTRINSIC_BUILD_SANDBOX or INTRINSIC_BUILD_TESTS is on, also without default features.
